stories.headline: GST Council to meet on September 12
stories.summary: The 57th [[GST Council]] meeting, chaired by the finance minister, will take up litigation reduction, input tax credit issues, compensation cess transition and possible changes to the petroleum tax framework.

stories.headline: Madhur Knit Crafts lists on NSE Emerge September 1
stories.summary: [[Madhur Knit Crafts Limited]]'s ₹53.27-crore SME IPO on NSE Emerge was subscribed 3.30x overall (individual investors 6.10x) at a price band of ₹95-100; allotment was finalised August 28 and shares list Tuesday, September 1, 2026.

stories.headline: Aar Shyam India Investment faces 26% open offer
stories.summary: [[Radha Krishna Avudari]], [[Sudha Rani Avudari]] and [[Nagabhyru Srikanth]] launched an open offer to acquire up to 26% of [[Aar Shyam India Investment Company]] at ₹15/share, following a share purchase agreement for a 40.54% stake from [[Guruomega Private Limited]]; tendering period runs October 16-30, 2026.

stories.headline: Brainbees Solutions (FirstCry) seeks nod to reallocate ₹216.2-crore IPO proceeds
stories.summary: [[Brainbees Solutions]] (FirstCry) proposed shifting unutilised IPO proceeds worth ₹216.2 crore away from BabyHug-branded stores and Saudi warehouse plans toward FirstCry-branded stores, technology/cloud infrastructure and sales & marketing, and widened its Globalbees Brands investment mandate; shareholders vote September 22, 2026.

stories.headline: Tembo Global Industries to redirect ₹114-crore preferential issue toward defence, solar units
stories.summary: [[Tembo Global Industries]] revised the utilisation plan for its ₹114-crore preferential issue proceeds, directing funds into subsidiaries and associates including Tembo PES JV, Tembo Solar Power, Tembo Renewal Energy and Tembo Classic Engineering for EPC, defence and working-capital needs.

stories.headline: Malls turn into F&B, entertainment hangouts as retail mix shifts
stories.summary: F&B and entertainment now account for 32% of mall leasing space in H1 CY26, up from ~20% in 2020, per [[Anarock Group]]. Apparel's share fell from 35% to 28% over the same period as [[DLF Retail]], [[LuLu Group India]], [[PVR INOX]] and [[KidZania India]] expand experiential formats.

stories.headline: Delhi CNG price rises ₹3.89/kg amid West Asia crisis
stories.summary: [[Indraprastha Gas]] raised CNG prices in Delhi-NCR by ₹3.89/kg to ₹86.98/kg, the fifth hike this year, as the West Asia conflict disrupts LNG cargo through the Strait of Hormuz and pushes up import costs.

stories.headline: New e-scooter launches from Ather, Simple Energy target mass market
stories.summary: [[Ather Energy]] launched its Konarc scooter at ₹99,999, built on a new EL platform, aiming to pull customers from petrol scooters like the [[Honda Activa]]; [[Simple Energy]]'s Simple Wave, [[Honda]]'s QC3 and [[Ultraviolette]]'s Tesseract are also launching soon.

stories.headline: 'Humanising' AI: apps now add deliberate mistakes to sound more human
stories.summary: Startups including [[ElevenLabs]], [[OpenAI]], [[Hume AI]], [[WriteHuman]] and [[StealthWriter]] are building tools that add natural imperfections — filler words, background noise, uneven phrasing — to make AI-generated text, voice and video sound more human and harder to detect.

stories.headline: Premium condiments and jamun-flavoured drinks gain shelf space
stories.summary: Indian condiment makers including [[Nestle]], [[Hindustan Unilever]], [[Craft Heinz]] and [[Capital Foods]] are launching global-fusion sauces and pastes as 40% of urban Indians seek exotic flavours, per an [[IMARC]] report; separately, jamun is showing up in premium drinks from [[Diageo India]]'s Smirnoff, [[Radico Khaitan]] and [[Kwality Wall's]] ice cream.

stories.headline: Nepal may need $4-5 billion to rebuild after floods
stories.summary: Nepal's finance minister [[Swarnim Wagle]] estimated $4-5 billion is needed to rebuild after floods killed over 675 people, with nearly 3,000 still missing; India and China have sent relief teams and tunnel-rescue crews.

stories.headline: Kashmiris can see climate change, but schools and awareness lag
stories.summary: Farmers, tourism workers and students across Jammu & Kashmir report warmer winters, shrinking snowfall and erratic rain, but a Yale survey found 58% of Indians know little about climate science; the J&K Climate Change Action Plan flags weak public awareness as a key resilience gap.

stories.headline: OpenAI to cut off AI models for SpaceX
stories.summary: [[OpenAI]] said it will stop providing AI models to [[Cursor]], the coding-tool company owned by [[Elon Musk]]'s [[SpaceX]], citing concerns SpaceX will use the technology outside its contract terms — a fresh escalation between [[OpenAI]] CEO [[Sam Altman]] and Musk.

stories.headline: Iran acknowledges war toll on economy but signals no retreat
stories.summary: Iranian leaders admitted sanctions and war with the US have shrunk foreign trade by a third and complicated inflation control, but the government reiterated no retreat on its nuclear stance six months after US-Israel strikes on Iranian sites.

stories.headline: US taking partial control of Venezuela's oil reserves: Trump
stories.summary: [[Donald Trump]] said US-linked companies secured majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan proven oil reserves through a partnership with [[PDVSA]] interim president [[Delcy Rodriguez]], as Washington deepens pressure on [[Venezuela]].

stories.headline: PM Modi holds talks with Uzbekistan on two-day visit
stories.summary: [[Narendra Modi]] met Uzbekistan President [[Shavkat Mirziyoyev]] in Tashkent during a two-day visit, with both leaders set to discuss bilateral cooperation.

stories.headline: Lenders to challenge NCLAT order on Chandra repayment plan
stories.summary: [[LIC Housing Finance]], [[Union Bank of India]] and [[Canara Bank]] plan to challenge before the NCLAT the repayment plan approved for [[Essel Group]] founder [[Subhash Chandra]], under which creditors get just ₹6.25 crore against admitted claims of ₹22,006.57 crore.

stories.headline: FSSAI bans hing sale by Everest, Laljee Godhoo
stories.summary: [[FSSAI]] prohibited sale of compounded asafoetida made by [[Everest Food Products]] and [[Laljee Godhoo and Company]] after lab tests found sub-standard alcohol-soluble extract (0%) and hing content (3.29-4.4%) against a required minimum of 5%.

stories.headline: Paradise Plastics Enterprises insolvency: EOI invited for resolution plan
stories.summary: The resolution professional for [[Paradise Plastics Enterprises Limited]], undergoing corporate insolvency at its Ahmednagar auto-components plant, invited expressions of interest for a resolution plan, with the final list of prospective resolution applicants due by October 14, 2026.

stories.headline: Bank of Maharashtra to e-auction 19 mortgaged properties in Pune
stories.summary: [[Bank of Maharashtra]]'s Pune East Zone will e-auction 19 residential, commercial and land properties on September 15, 2026 under SARFAESI to recover dues from defaulting borrowers across Bhigwan, Malegaon, Baramati, Yerawada and Lulla Nagar branches.

stories.headline: Grey's Exim assets go under liquidation e-auction
stories.summary: The liquidator for [[Grey's Exim Private Limited]] will e-auction two commercial units in Thane on September 19, 2026 as part of the corporate insolvency liquidation process.

stories.headline: Banks issue SARFAESI possession and demand notices across Maharashtra
stories.summary: [[Central Bank of India]] issued a possession notice against [[Neelam Sushil Singhvi]] and [[Shushil Shantilal Singhvi]] (Bhiwandi, ₹39.82 lakh); [[Bank of Baroda]] issued notices to [[Zaheer Gulam Shaikh]] (Virar) and took possession from [[Anil Singh]] and [[Anvarika Singh]] (Vasai, ₹18.76 lakh); [[Ambit Finvest]] will e-auction four Vajreshwari properties linked to [[Asha Grain Store]] and [[Vijay Pandharinath Pakhare]]; [[Karnataka Bank]] declared a Powai flat linked to [[Harriet Roselind Joseph]] and [[Japa Singh Joseph]] an NPA over ₹14.82 lakh in dues.

stories.headline: HDFC Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, TCS process loss-of-securities claims
stories.summary: [[HDFC Bank]], [[Kotak Mahindra Bank]] and [[Tata Consultancy Services]] published notices for issuing duplicate share certificates after original holders reported lost or mislaid securities; objections must be filed within 15 days.

stories.headline: Vishnu Chemicals opens special window for physical share transfers
stories.summary: [[Vishnu Chemicals Limited]] reopened a special SEBI-mandated window until specified cut-off dates for shareholders to re-lodge physical share transfer deeds that were rejected or not processed since 2019.

stories.headline: Foundry Fuel Products invites re-lodgement of frozen physical shares
stories.summary: [[Foundry Fuel Products Limited]] asked shareholders whose physical securities were frozen under SEBI's April 2019 dematerialisation rules to submit re-lodgement or transmission requests along with KYC documents.

stories.headline: PNB, Assam Electricity Grid Corp, Singareni Collieries float tenders
stories.summary: [[Punjab National Bank]] invited bids to replace current transformers at its Dwarka corporate office; [[Assam Electricity Grid Corporation]] floated a tender for de-stringing and stringing of HTLS conductor on its transmission lines; [[Singareni Collieries]] issued e-procurement tenders for mining equipment and services.

stories.headline: Companies notify AGMs and e-voting windows for FY26
stories.summary: AGM and remote e-voting notices were published by [[Aarti Pharmalabs]], [[Touchwood Entertainment]], [[MAKS Energy Solutions India]], [[Integrity Infrabuild Developers]], [[Bajaj Healthcare]], [[Signpost India]], [[Comfort Intech]], [[Megastar Foods]], [[Dharani Sugars and Chemicals]], [[INDO-MIM]], [[Comfort Fincap]], [[Brainbees Solutions]], [[Genus Paper & Boards]], [[Shanti Educational Initiatives]], [[Pyramid Technoplast]], [[Dharmaj Crop Guard]], [[Western Carriers India]], [[BLS International Services]], [[Transformers and Rectifiers India]], [[Mold-Tek Packaging]], [[Dharani Finance]], [[Hemant Surgical Industries]], [[Supra Pacific Financial Services]], [[Infra Industries]], [[Trustwave Securities]], [[Capri Global Capital]], [[Sudarshan Pharma Industries]], [[Marinetrans India]], [[PDP Shipping & Projects]], [[Simplex Infrastructures]], [[Esquire Money Guarantees]], [[TCI Developers]], [[Medico Remedies]], [[Premier Energies]], [[Panabyte Technologies]], [[Rajputana Biodiesel]], [[Univastu India]], [[Euro Pratik Sales]] and [[NDL Ventures]].

stories.headline: FM urges US investors to make in India for the world
stories.summary: [[Nirmala Sitharaman]] invited US businesses to co-develop and manufacture in India during her Chicago roundtable, citing India's engineering talent, scale and digital infrastructure such as [[Aadhaar]], [[UPI]] and [[India Stack]].

stories.headline: India, Argentina in talks for expansion of lithium mining
stories.summary: India's [[KABIL]] (Khanij Bidesh India) has advanced Phase-II drilling at its lithium project in Argentina's Catamarca province and is exploring further tie-ups in Salta and Jujuy as part of the South America Lithium Triangle.

stories.headline: HDFC Bank CEO to step down
stories.summary: [[HDFC Bank]] MD & CEO [[Sashidhar Jagdishan]] will not seek re-appointment when his term ends October 26; the board will fast-track selection of a successor. His tenure faced scrutiny over the [[Credit Suisse]] AT1 bond mis-selling issue and the [[HDFC]] merger integration.

stories.headline: 'Our push is premium; a budget brand just food for thought': ITC Hotels MD
stories.summary: [[ITC Hotels]] MD [[Anil Chadha]] said the group targets a 50-55% premiumisation share within five years, plans to grow its managed portfolio from 8,600 to 15,000 keys, and is pursuing expansion in Dubai, Sri Lanka and Nepal.

stories.headline: Temasek backs Singapore Airlines' Air India investment
stories.summary: [[Temasek]] said it supports [[Singapore Airlines]]'s investment in [[Air India]] amid concerns over the carrier's transformation; SIA holds 25.1% in [[Air India]] after [[Tata Sons]] acquired the government's stake in January 2022.

stories.headline: Dilmah chairman: fine tea remains an untapped market in South Asia
stories.summary: [[Dilmah]] chairman [[Dilhan C Fernando]] said India's premium hospitality boom offers an opportunity for fine tea despite historically thin margins, as the company launches its India-exclusive Thambapanni Luxury Collection with 26 artisanal tea and spice blends.

stories.headline: Musafir Cafe's 'Nayi Hindi' signals a new grammar for Hindi storytelling
stories.summary: Columnist [[Ashwani Kumar]] argues [[Divya Prakash Dubey]]'s novel-turned-Netflix hit 'Musafir Cafe' captures Gen Z's language and attitudes toward love and marriage through hybrid, colloquial Hindi-English prose.

stories.headline: Small dreams deserve as much focus as big infrastructure goals: Tavleen Singh
stories.summary: Columnist [[Tavleen Singh]] writes India's push for big-ticket infrastructure and a 2047 developed-nation vision has come at the cost of small but essential fixes — clean water, functioning schools and toilets — citing a Yale survey ranking India near the bottom on environmental performance.

stories.headline: New book 'Open to Work' argues AI creates opportunities, not just threats
stories.summary: In their book 'Open to Work', [[LinkedIn]] CEO [[Ryan Roslansky]] and chief economic opportunity officer [[Aneesh Raman]] argue AI is a general-purpose technology like electricity, and identify five human skills — curiosity, courage, creativity, compassion and communication — that AI cannot replicate.

stories.headline: India's esports contingent eyes 11 medal events at Asian Games
stories.summary: India will field 15 esports athletes across titles including [[League of Legends]], DOTA 2 and Street Fighter V at the September 19-October 4 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, where esports offers a record 11 of 469 medal events; India's gaming market has crossed $1 billion in annual revenue, per [[Niko Partners]].

stories.headline: Chronic neck and back pain rising sharply among young adults
stories.summary: Doctors report a growing number of patients aged 18-35 with chronic neck and back pain, driven by prolonged screen time, poor posture and sedentary work-from-home routines; the WHO projects global cases of lower back pain will rise from 450 million in 2025 to 843 million by 2050.
